mapper.insert: insert into QUEST ( USER_ID, SIMULATION_ID, SIMULATION_ITEM_ID, TRANSACTION_ID, QUEST_TYPE, QUEST_TITLE, QUEST_DEADLINE, QUEST_STATUS, QUEST_URL, EXP_REWARD, QUEST_COMPLETED_AT ) values ( #{userId}, #{simulationId}, #{simulationItemId}, #{transactionId}, #{questType}, #{displayName}, #{questDeadline}, #{questStatus}, #{questUrl}, #{expReward}, #{questCompletedAt} )
mapper.select: select Q.QUEST_ID as questId, Q.USER_ID as userId, Q.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, Q.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, Q.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, Q.QUEST_TITLE as displayName, Q.QUEST_DEADLINE as questDeadline, Q.QUEST_STATUS as questStatus, Q.QUEST_URL as questUrl, Q.EXP_REWARD as expReward, Q.QUEST_COMPLETED_AT as questCompletedAt from QUEST Q where Q.USER_ID = #{userId} order by Q.QUEST_ID asc

select Q.QUEST_ID as questId, Q.USER_ID as userId, Q.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, Q.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, Q.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, Q.QUEST_TITLE as displayName, Q.QUEST_DEADLINE as questDeadline, Q.QUEST_STATUS as questStatus, Q.QUEST_URL as questUrl, Q.EXP_REWARD as expReward, Q.QUEST_COMPLETED_AT as questCompletedAt from QUEST Q where Q.SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} order by Q.QUEST_ID asc

select Q.QUEST_ID as questId, Q.USER_ID as userId, Q.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, Q.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, Q.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, Q.QUEST_TITLE as displayName, Q.QUEST_DEADLINE as questDeadline, Q.QUEST_STATUS as questStatus, Q.QUEST_URL as questUrl, Q.EXP_REWARD as expReward, Q.QUEST_COMPLETED_AT as questCompletedAt from QUEST Q where Q.QUEST_ID = #{questId}
select * from QUEST where SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} and QUEST_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' for update
mapper.update: update QUEST set QUEST_STATUS = 'NOT_COMPLETED' where QUEST_ID = #{questId} and QUEST_STATUS = 'COMPLETED'
update QUEST set QUEST_STATUS = #{questStatus}, QUEST_COMPLETED_AT = case when #{questStatus} = 'COMPLETED' then now() else null end where QUEST_ID = #{questId}
